task: Find the R equivalent of a Stata command
task_zh: 查找 Stata 命令对应的 R 函数
detail: Bare words and comma-separated names work: findit(tab, sex, region). Add hints such as findit(tab, gen), or quote full Stata syntax. One clear example is shown by default; print(n = Inf) reveals every match. findit() with no argument returns the whole list.
detail_zh: 单个词和逗号分隔的变量名都可以不加引号，例如 findit(tab, sex, region)。可以加入 findit(tab, gen) 这样的提示，完整 Stata 语法仍可放在引号内。默认显示一个明确的例子；print(n = Inf) 显示所有匹配项。不带参数的 findit() 返回完整列表。

detail: Prints every row and column without storing print preferences. print_headtail(data) shows up to 10 data rows split between the beginning and end, with a row of dots marking an omitted middle; print_interval(data) shows approximately evenly spaced rows without separator rows. Both return the complete input invisibly and keep existing preview preferences. To retain a compact display for later operations, use preview(), preview_headtail() or preview_interval(); unpreview() restores ordinary printing. These helpers keep all data; n controls displayed data rows, not omission markers.
detail_zh: 打印所有行和列，不保存打印偏好。print_headtail(data) 最多显示首尾共 10 行数据，用一行省略号标记省略的中间部分；print_interval(data) 显示近似等间隔行，不插入分隔行。两者都不可见地返回完整输入，并保留已有预览偏好。如需在后续操作中保留紧凑显示，请用 preview()、preview_headtail() 或 preview_interval()；unpreview() 恢复普通打印。这些函数均保留全部数据；n 控制显示的数据行数，省略标记不计入其中。

task_zh: Pearson 相关系数（仅用完整个案）
detail: Uses one common complete-case sample within each group, like Stata correlate. Returns r and n without p-values; .wide = TRUE gives a lower-triangular table. Optional .wt supports frequency or analytic weights; zero-weight rows are excluded. Stata covariance, means and display-formatting options are not implemented. Use pwcorr() for separate pairwise samples, or pwcorr(.listwise = TRUE) for a common sample with p-values.
detail_zh: 与 Stata correlate 一样，在各组内使用同一完整个案样本。返回 r 和 n，不含 p 值；.wide = TRUE 返回下三角表。.wt 支持频数或分析权重，零权重行被排除。未实现 Stata 的 covariance、means 和显示格式选项。各对变量使用各自完整样本时请用 pwcorr()；需要同一完整样本及 p 值时请用 pwcorr(.listwise = TRUE)。

detail: By default, each pair uses its own complete sample and returns Pearson r, n and p; .wide = TRUE gives a lower-triangular table without n or p. Stata prints a matrix by default and needs sig obs to show p-values and counts. .listwise = TRUE (also Stata casewise) uses one common sample and keeps p-values; corr() uses that sample but omits p. .adjust = "bonferroni" or "sidak" adjusts across all distinct variable pairs separately within each group, including pairs with undefined p-values; adjustment is unavailable with .wide = TRUE. .method = "spearman" gives unweighted pairwise rank correlations; spearman() uses Stata's casewise default. Pearson weights use summed frequency weights or analytic row counts for n; complete zero-weight rows count for analytic n only in pairwise mode. Fractional frequency weights extend Stata's integer convention.
detail_zh: 默认每对变量使用各自的完整样本，返回 Pearson r、n 和 p；.wide = TRUE 返回不含 n 或 p 的下三角表。Stata 默认打印矩阵，需加 sig obs 才显示 p 值和样本量。.listwise = TRUE 对应 Stata 的 listwise 或 casewise，使用同一完整样本并保留 p 值；corr() 使用该样本但不返回 p 值。.adjust = "bonferroni" 或 "sidak" 在各组内按所有不同变量对的数量校正，包括 p 值未定义的变量对；不能与 .wide = TRUE 同用。.method = "spearman" 计算不加权的成对秩相关；spearman() 默认与 Stata 一样使用同一完整样本。Pearson 加权时，n 为频数权重之和或分析权重的行数；完整的零权重行仅在成对删除模式下计入分析权重的 n。允许小数频数权重是对 Stata 整数权重约定的扩展。

detail: R's default is Welch's test; add var.equal = TRUE for Stata's default equal-variance test.
detail_zh: R 默认使用 Welch 检验；加上 var.equal = TRUE 即为 Stata 默认的等方差检验。

detail: Filter missing values on both variables for plain Stata tabulate, chi2. tab2 otherwise includes its displayed missing categories in the Pearson test. tidystata retains missing categories by default; Stata tabulate excludes them unless missing is specified. Use .missing = FALSE to match Stata.
detail_zh: 为匹配不带missing选项的Stata tabulate, chi2，先剔除任一变量缺失的观测；否则tab2将显示的缺失类别也纳入Pearson检验。 tidystata 默认保留缺失类别；Stata tabulate 仅在指定 missing 时保留。使用 .missing = FALSE 可匹配 Stata。

detail: t.test(data$x) also reports the confidence interval. The R snippet returns point summaries only (plus SE for mean); Stata also reports confidence intervals and estimation results.
detail_zh: t.test(data$x) 还会给出置信区间。 R 代码仅返回点汇总（mean 另含标准误）；Stata 还报告置信区间并保存估计结果。

detail_zh: 加上 conf.level = 0.99 相当于 ci mean x, level(99)。

detail: tab(data, x) shows the same percentages; prop.test() adds a confidence interval for one proportion. The R snippet returns point summaries only (plus SE for mean); Stata also reports confidence intervals and estimation results.
detail_zh: tab(data, x) 给出同样的百分比；prop.test() 可以给出单个比例的置信区间。 R 代码仅返回点汇总（mean 另含标准误）；Stata 还报告置信区间并保存估计结果。

r: prop.test(sum(data$x == 1, na.rm = TRUE), sum(!is.na(data$x)), p = 0.5, correct = FALSE)
detail: correct = FALSE gives Stata's normal-approximation test without continuity correction. The uncorrected test statistic matches the normal approximation, but prop.test() confidence intervals use score inversion rather than the prtest Wald interval.
detail_zh: correct = FALSE 对应 Stata 不做连续性校正的正态近似检验。 关闭校正后检验统计量对应正态近似，但 prop.test() 置信区间使用得分反演，而 prtest 使用 Wald 区间。

detail: R can choose exact inference in small samples and applies continuity correction in its normal approximation; Stata defaults differ. Set exact and correct deliberately.
detail_zh: R 对小样本可能使用精确推断，正态近似默认作连续性校正；Stata 默认不同。应明确指定 exact 和 correct。

detail: R can choose exact inference in small samples and applies continuity correction in its normal approximation; Stata defaults differ. Set exact and correct deliberately.
detail_zh: R 对小样本可能使用精确推断，正态近似默认作连续性校正；Stata 默认不同。应明确指定 exact 和 correct。

detail: The R code assumes group codes 0 and 1; exact/asymptotic inference and tied-value handling can differ from Stata ksmirnov.

detail: bartlett.test(y ~ group, data = data) gives the equal-variance test that oneway reports. aov() gives the ANOVA table but does not include the Bartlett equal-variance test printed by oneway; request bartlett.test() separately.
detail_zh: bartlett.test(y ~ group, data = data) 给出 oneway 报告的方差齐性检验。 aov() 给出方差分析表，但不含 oneway 打印的 Bartlett 等方差检验；该检验须另用 bartlett.test()。

detail: shapiro.test() accepts 3 to 5000 nonmissing observations; Stata swilk has different sample-size limits and reporting.
detail_zh: shapiro.test() 接受 3 至 5000 个非缺失观测；Stata swilk 的样本量限制和报告方式不同。

detail: For a formal normality test use shapiro.test(data$x).
detail_zh: 正式的正态性检验可用 shapiro.test(data$x)。

detail: Uses one common complete-case sample by default, like Stata spearman; .pairwise = TRUE matches spearman, pw. Returns an ungrouped table with var1, var2, r (rho), n and p, plus any grouping keys. P-values follow Stata 18+'s four-moment beta approximation, with a normal fallback for n < 4 or an invalid beta fit; p is NA for n < 3. Ties receive average ranks within each sample. Constant variables give NA, where Stata reports rho = 1. Weights are unsupported. .adjust = "bonferroni" or "sidak" adjusts within each group across all distinct pairs, including undefined p-values; it cannot be combined with .wide = TRUE. Base R cor.test(..., method = "spearman") uses different p-value approximations.
detail_zh: 默认与 Stata spearman 一样使用同一完整个案样本；.pairwise = TRUE 对应 spearman, pw。返回未分组的表，包含分组键（如有）、var1、var2、r（rho）、n 和 p。p 值采用 Stata 18 起的四阶矩 beta 近似；n < 4 或 beta 拟合无效时采用正态近似，n < 3 时 p 为 NA。并列值在各自样本内取平均秩。常量变量的相关系数为 NA，而 Stata 报告 rho = 1。不支持权重。.adjust = "bonferroni" 或 "sidak" 在各组内按所有不同变量对的数量校正，包括 p 值未定义的变量对；不能与 .wide = TRUE 同用。base R 的 cor.test(..., method = "spearman") 使用不同的 p 值近似。

detail: The rank coefficient has the same interpretation, but exact/asymptotic p-value selection and tie corrections may differ; match inference options separately.
detail_zh: 秩相关系数含义相同，但精确或渐近 p 值的选择和并列值校正可能不同；需另行匹配推断选项。

r: prcomp(na.omit(select(data, x1, x2, x3)), scale. = TRUE)
detail: Stata analyses the correlation matrix, so scale. = TRUE matches it. scale. = TRUE matches correlation PCA; signs of eigenvectors are arbitrary and the stored rotations and printed loadings have different normalization conventions.
detail_zh: Stata 基于相关矩阵进行分析，因此 scale. = TRUE 与之一致。 scale. = TRUE 对应相关矩阵主成分分析；特征向量正负号可任意翻转，保存的旋转向量和打印载荷的归一化规则不同。

detail: factanal() uses maximum likelihood; psych::fa(..., fm = "pa") gives Stata's default principal-factor method.
detail_zh: factanal() 使用最大似然法；psych::fa(..., fm = "pa") 对应 Stata 默认的主因子法。

detail: Stata numeric missing values compare larger than every finite number; R comparisons return NA. Handle missing values explicitly before applying the condition.
detail_zh: Stata 数值缺失比较时大于所有有限数；R 比较返回 NA。应先明确处理缺失，再使用条件。

task_zh: 条件不成立时报错停止
detail: Both FALSE and NA count as failures. Errors report failing counts and the first five failing row numbers per condition; success returns the unchanged data invisibly, so it fits in a pipe. Unlike Stata, missing x fails x > 0: use assert(data, is.na(x) | x > 0) for Stata's behaviour.
detail_zh: FALSE 和 NA 都视为失败。错误会逐条件报告失败数量和前五个失败行号；成功时不可见地返回原数据，可用于管道。与 Stata 不同，x 缺失时 x > 0 不通过；要采用 Stata 的行为，请用 assert(data, is.na(x) | x > 0)。

task_zh: 每个变量的缺失值数目

r: mutate(data, gender = factor(gender, levels = 1:2, labels = c("male", "female")))
task: Label every value of a categorical variable
task_zh: 给数值变量的所有取值贴上标签
detail: In R a labelled categorical variable is usually a factor. Give levels explicitly so each code gets the right label.
detail_zh: R 中带标签的类别变量通常用因子（factor）存储。请明确写出 levels，确保每个取值对应正确的标签。

task_zh: 给数值变量的部分取值贴上标签
detail: haven preserves partial value labels for a round trip to Stata. tab() displays value labels; codebook() reports counts and variable labels rather than value-label mappings.
detail_zh: haven 保留部分取值的标签，便于与 Stata 互通。tab() 显示数值标签；codebook() 报告个数和变量标签，不列出数值标签映射。

detail: Labels read from Stata files are kept; variables() and codebook() display them.
detail_zh: 从 Stata 文件读入的变量标签会被保留；variables() 和 codebook() 会显示它们。

task: Show the categories of a variable
detail: For labelled data read with haven, use haven::print_labels(data$x).
detail_zh: 对于用 haven 读入的带标签数据，可用 haven::print_labels(data$x)。

task_zh: 把文本变量转换成带标签的数值变量
detail: factor() creates integer level indices with an R class; encode creates numeric codes with a separate value-label definition. Collation can change code ordering.
detail_zh: factor() 创建带 R 类别的整数水平编号；encode 创建数值编码和独立值标签定义。排序规则可能改变编号顺序。

task_zh: 把带标签的数值变量转换成文本变量

task: Attach a value label to a variable
task_zh: 把数值标签加到变量上
detail: Define the labels once, as yesno <- c(No = 0, Yes = 1), then attach them to any variable; factor() is the usual R alternative.
detail_zh: 先定义一次标签，例如 yesno <- c(No = 0, Yes = 1)，再加到任意变量上；R 中更常用的做法是 factor()。

task: Attach a note to a variable
detail: R has no notes system; an attribute or a comment in the script is the usual substitute.
detail_zh: R 没有 notes 功能；通常用属性或脚本中的注释代替。

detail: Assign the result to keep it: data <- mutate(data, ...). R has no separate generate and replace.
detail_zh: 需要把结果赋值回去才能保留：data <- mutate(data, ...)。R 不区分 generate 和 replace。

detail: Add .by = group for the number of rows in each group, like bysort group: generate N = _N.
detail_zh: 加上 .by = group 即为每组的行数，相当于 bysort group: generate N = _N。

task: Create a variable under a condition
detail: In Stata missing is larger than any number, so x > 0 is true for missing x. In R the condition is NA and so is the result.
detail_zh: Stata 中缺失值大于任何数，所以缺失的 x 满足 x > 0；R 中该条件为 NA，结果也为 NA。

task: Create a variable for some rows

task_zh: 根据条件生成逻辑变量/虚拟变量
detail: Stata numeric equality is false for missing operands; %in% keeps the dummy zero when either input is missing. The R result is logical TRUE/FALSE rather than numeric 1/0; use as.integer() when the stored type matters.
detail_zh: Stata的数值等式对缺失值返回假；%in%使任一输入缺失时虚拟变量为零。 R 结果为逻辑值 TRUE/FALSE，而非数值 1/0；需要一致存储类型时使用 as.integer()。

detail: This shifts rows, like x[_n-1], and ignores gaps in time. See L. for panel lags.
detail_zh: 这与 x[_n-1] 一样按行移动，不考虑时间上的间隔。面板数据的滞后请查看 L.。

detail: mutate(x2 = x) copies the R vector and attributes, but does not reproduce all Stata clonevar characteristics and notes.
detail_zh: mutate(x2 = x) 复制 R 向量和属性，但不完整复现 Stata clonevar 的变量特征及注释。

task: Change a variable under a condition
detail: Stata numeric missing values compare larger than every finite number; R comparisons return NA. Handle missing values explicitly before applying the condition.
detail_zh: Stata 数值缺失比较时大于所有有限数；R 比较返回 NA。应先明确处理缺失，再使用条件。

task: Change a variable for some rows

task_zh: 生成（类别变量）x 所有取值的虚拟变量
detail: as_dummy(data, x, .names = "index") numbers the columns x_1, x_2, ... as Stata does. Also: fastDummies::dummy_cols(data, "x"). as_dummy() defaults to value-based column names; .names = "index" gives numbered Stata-style suffixes. Check the missing-category indicator policy too.
detail_zh: as_dummy(data, x, .names = "index") 像 Stata 一样把新列编号为 x_1、x_2……。也可用 fastDummies::dummy_cols(data, "x")。 as_dummy() 默认按取值命名列；.names = "index" 可生成 Stata 式编号后缀。还须核对缺失类别指示列规则。

detail: Values that match no condition become NA, like else = . in Stata.
detail_zh: 不满足任何条件的取值为 NA，相当于 Stata 的 else = .。

task_zh: 把某个取值改为缺失值
把缺失值代码改为缺失值
detail: mvdecode(x, c(-8, -9)) handles several codes, like mv(-8 -9).
detail_zh: mvdecode(x, c(-8, -9)) 可同时处理多个代码，如 mv(-8 -9)。

task: Turn missing values into a code
task_zh: 把缺失值改为特定取值
把文本变量转换成数值变量
detail: Text that is not a number becomes NA with a warning, as with force. destring(str_x, ignore = "kg") removes those characters first, like ignore(), so "10 kg" gives 10. Invalid numeric text becomes NA with a warning here; Stata destring without force refuses conversion of a variable containing such text.
detail_zh: 不是数字的文本会变为 NA 并给出警告，相当于 force 选项。destring(str_x, ignore = "kg") 会先删除这些字符，相当于 ignore()，因此 "10 kg" 得到 10。 无效数字文本在此变为 NA 并警告；Stata destring 未指定 force 时拒绝转换含此类文本的变量。

task_zh: 把数值变量转换成文本变量
detail: Labelled values keep their codes; decode() gives the value labels instead. Formatting and retained precision can differ from Stata tostring; choose an explicit format when exact text or round-trip precision matters.
detail_zh: 带标签的变量保留数值代码；decode() 则返回数值标签。 格式和保留精度可能与 Stata tostring 不同；需要精确文本或往返精度时须明确格式。

detail: xtile() follows Stata's rule, so equal values stay in the same group. Returns an ordered factor by default, or integer codes with labels = FALSE. Inside grouped mutate(), the default is integer codes; labels = TRUE explicitly requests labels.
detail_zh: xtile() 遵循 Stata 的规则，相同取值总在同一组。 默认返回有序因子，labels = FALSE 返回整数代码。在分组 mutate() 中默认返回整数代码；labels = TRUE 显式请求标签。

task: Ten groups of about equal size
task_zh: 根据分位数，将连续变量均等地分成类别变量
detail: egen cut(), group() has its own grouping rule; xtile() follows Stata's xtile, the usual command for quantile groups.
detail_zh: egen cut(), group() 有自己的分组规则；xtile() 遵循 Stata 的 xtile，这是分位数分组的常用命令。

r: mutate(data, bins = cut(x, breaks = seq(0, 100, 10), right = FALSE))
detail: right = FALSE makes each interval include its lower cutpoint, as egen cut() does. cut_length(x, 10) instead splits the range into 10 equal widths. cut() returns a factor of interval labels; egen cut() stores numeric lower endpoints even when interval closure matches.
detail_zh: right = FALSE 使每个区间包含下限，与 egen cut() 一致。cut_length(x, 10) 则把取值范围等宽地分成 10 组。 cut() 返回带区间标签的因子；egen cut() 即使区间开闭一致，仍存储数值下界。

task_zh: 多个变量逐行求最小值
多个变量逐行求最大值
多个变量逐行求中位数
多个变量逐行求标准差

task: Number of missing values in each row
Number of observed values in each row
task_zh: 逐行计算非缺失值个数

task: Number of distinct values in each row
detail: From egenmore (SSC). Missing values are ignored unless .missing = TRUE, like the missing option.
detail_zh: 来自 egenmore（SSC）。默认忽略缺失值；.missing = TRUE 相当于 missing 选项。

task: Sample statistic as a new variable
task_zh: 通过计算函数生成新变量
detail: R functions keep missing values unless na.rm = TRUE; Stata's egen ignores them. For an all-missing group mean(..., na.rm = TRUE) gives NaN; Stata egen mean() gives numeric missing. Normalize NaN if that distinction matters.
detail_zh: R 函数默认不忽略缺失值，需要 na.rm = TRUE；Stata 的 egen 会自动忽略。 全缺失组的 mean(..., na.rm = TRUE) 返回 NaN；Stata egen mean() 返回数值缺失。需要区分时应统一 NaN。

r: mutate(data, x_avg = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), .by = group)
task: Group statistic as a new variable
detail: For an all-missing group mean(..., na.rm = TRUE) gives NaN; Stata egen mean() gives numeric missing. Normalize NaN if that distinction matters.
detail_zh: 全缺失组的 mean(..., na.rm = TRUE) 返回 NaN；Stata egen mean() 返回数值缺失。需要区分时应统一 NaN。

r: data |> group_by(g1, g2) |> mutate(id = cur_group_id()) |> ungroup()
detail: cur_group_id() also numbers groups with missing keys; egen group() excludes those rows without the missing option. String collation can change ID ordering.
detail_zh: cur_group_id() 也为缺失键分组编号；egen group() 未指定 missing 时排除这些行。字符串排序也可能改变编号顺序。

task: Mark the first row of each group
detail: Gives TRUE/FALSE; rows with a missing group are FALSE, as in Stata, unless .missing = TRUE. The R result is logical TRUE/FALSE rather than numeric 1/0; use as.integer() when the stored type matters.
detail_zh: 返回 TRUE/FALSE；与 Stata 相同，分组变量缺失的行为 FALSE，除非设置 .missing = TRUE。 R 结果为逻辑值 TRUE/FALSE，而非数值 1/0；需要一致存储类型时使用 as.integer()。

detail: Base R: as.vector(scale(x)). Add .by = g for by g: egen.
detail_zh: base R：as.vector(scale(x))。加 .by = g 即 by g: egen。

detail: pc(x, prop = TRUE) gives proportions, like the prop option.
detail_zh: pc(x, prop = TRUE) 给出比例，即 prop 选项。

task_zh: 在第 1 和第 99 百分位缩尾
detail: datawizard uses R quantile cutpoints while winsor2 uses Stata percentile rules; small samples and ties can therefore yield different caps.
detail_zh: datawizard 使用 R 分位数切点，winsor2 使用 Stata 百分位规则；小样本和并列值可能产生不同截尾边界。

detail: Note the order: new name = old name.
detail_zh: 注意顺序：新名字 = 旧名字。

task_zh: 批量重命名变量到小写

r: summarise(data, across(c(x1, x2), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .by = group)
task: Replace the data with group means
task_zh: 用统计量分组描述若干变量，并替换原数据
detail: Assign the result to replace the data, as collapse does: data <- summarise(...). summ(data, x1, x2, .by = group) shows a summary table instead. R retains missing grouping keys; Stata tabstat by() and tabulate summarize() exclude missing grouping categories unless requested. Check the intended grouping sample.
detail_zh: 像 collapse 一样替换数据需要赋值：data <- summarise(...)。summ(data, x1, x2, .by = group) 则只显示汇总表。 R 保留缺失分组键；Stata tabstat by() 和 tabulate summarize() 默认排除缺失分组类别。应核对分组样本。

stata: collapse (count) n = x (sum) total = y, by(group)
r: summarise(data, n = sum(!is.na(x)), total = sum(y, na.rm = TRUE), .by = group)
task_zh: 对不同变量使用不同的统计量
排序（相同取值取平均秩）
detail: rank() gives tied values their average rank, like egen rank(); dplyr::min_rank() gives them the lowest.
detail_zh: rank() 与 egen rank() 一样给相同取值平均秩；dplyr::min_rank() 则给最小秩。

r: mutate(data, tot = sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), .by = group)

task: Number of observed values in each group

r: dplyr::mutate(data, mx = if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE), .by = group)
detail: All-missing groups return NA without evaluating max() on an empty set. All-missing groups produce -Inf/Inf and a warning in R max/min with na.rm = TRUE; Stata egen max()/min() returns missing.
detail_zh: 全缺失组返回NA，不对空集合调用max()。 全缺失组的 R max/min 在 na.rm = TRUE 时返回 -Inf/Inf 并警告；Stata egen max()/min() 返回缺失。

r: dplyr::mutate(data, mn = if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else min(x, na.rm = TRUE), .by = group)
detail: All-missing groups return NA without evaluating min() on an empty set. All-missing groups produce -Inf/Inf and a warning in R max/min with na.rm = TRUE; Stata egen max()/min() returns missing.
detail_zh: 全缺失组返回NA，不对空集合调用min()。 全缺失组的 R max/min 在 na.rm = TRUE 时返回 -Inf/Inf 并警告；Stata egen max()/min() 返回缺失。

r: mutate(data, s = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), .by = group)
mutate(data, med = median(x, na.rm = TRUE), .by = group)

task_zh: 把多个变量拼接成一个字符串
detail: paste() turns NA into the text "NA"; egen concat() follows Stata missing-value and numeric-display conventions.
detail_zh: paste() 将 NA 转成文本 "NA"；egen concat() 使用 Stata 缺失值及数值显示规则。

task: Count how many variables equal a value
task_zh: 计算等于某个值的变量个数

r: mutate(data, first = coalesce(x1, x2, x3, x4, x5))
task_zh: 多个变量中第一个非缺失值

r: mutate(data, last = coalesce(x5, x4, x3, x2, x1))
task_zh: 多个变量中最后一个非缺失值

detail: summ() uses Stata's percentile rule. quantile(x, type = 2) is close, but treats some whole positions, such as 100 * 0.3, as fractional. summ() returns percentile values in a summary table; pctile creates a dataset column containing the cutpoints.
detail_zh: summ() 使用 Stata 的百分位数规则。quantile(x, type = 2) 与之接近，但会把某些整数位置（如 100 * 0.3）当作非整数。 summ() 在汇总表中返回百分位数；pctile 创建包含切点的数据列。

task: One value if a condition holds, another if not
detail: With missing x, Stata's cond() takes the first value (missing counts as large); if_else() returns NA. Stata numeric missing values compare larger than every finite number; R comparisons return NA. Handle missing values explicitly before applying the condition.
detail_zh: x 缺失时，Stata 的 cond() 取第一个值（缺失值视为很大）；if_else() 返回 NA。 Stata 数值缺失比较时大于所有有限数；R 比较返回 NA。应先明确处理缺失，再使用条件。

task: Whether x equals any listed value
task_zh: x 是否等于列出的某个值
detail: %in% gives FALSE for missing x, as inlist() does. R returns a logical indicator rather than the numeric 1/0 stored by Stata generate; use as.integer() if the stored type matters.
detail_zh: x 缺失时 %in% 返回 FALSE，与 inlist() 一致。 R 返回逻辑指示值，而 Stata generate 存储数值 1/0；需要一致存储类型时使用 as.integer()。

task: Whether x lies within a range
task_zh: x 是否在某个范围内
detail: between() returns NA for missing x, whereas Stata's inrange() returns 0.
detail_zh: x 缺失时 between() 返回 NA，而 Stata 的 inrange() 返回 0。

detail: R returns a logical indicator rather than the numeric 1/0 stored by Stata generate; use as.integer() if the stored type matters.
detail_zh: R 返回逻辑指示值，而 Stata generate 存储数值 1/0；需要一致存储类型时使用 as.integer()。

detail: R's second argument is the number of decimals. R rounds halves to even (round(0.5) is 0); Stata rounds them up.
detail_zh: R 的第二个参数是小数位数。R 对 .5 采用四舍六入五成双（round(0.5) 为 0）；Stata 则向上取整。

detail: log10() matches Stata's log10(). R's log(0) is -Inf rather than missing. R log(0) gives -Inf and a negative input gives NaN with a warning; Stata ln() gives numeric missing for these invalid inputs.
detail_zh: log10() 对应 Stata 的 log10()。R 中 log(0) 为 -Inf，而不是缺失值。 R log(0) 返回 -Inf，负输入返回 NaN 并警告；Stata ln() 对这些无效输入返回数值缺失。

detail: R and Stata use different random-number streams; the same numeric seed does not reproduce the same draws or selected rows.
detail_zh: R 与 Stata 使用不同随机数流；相同数值种子不会复现相同随机数或抽样行。

detail: Stata's sum() function treats missing values as 0, hence coalesce(x, 0).
detail_zh: Stata 的 sum() 函数把缺失值当作 0，因此这里用 coalesce(x, 0)。

detail: R chooses storage automatically, so there is no compress either.
detail_zh: R 自动选择存储类型，因此也不需要 compress。

detail: R stores the number unchanged and formats it only when printing, for example with round(x, 2) or sprintf().
detail_zh: R 不改变存储的数值，只在显示时设定格式，例如 round(x, 2) 或 sprintf()。

detail_zh: 也可以按位置选择：select(data, 1, 3:5)。select_or_transmute() 还可以同时计算新变量。

detail: Positions work too: select(data, -c(1, 3:5)).
detail_zh: 也可以按位置删除：select(data, -c(1, 3:5))。

detail_zh: Stata 会保留 x 缺失的行；R 中用 | is.na(x) 达到相同效果。

detail_zh: dplyr 中的对应写法是 distinct(data, x1, x2, .keep_all = TRUE)。

task: Run code and keep its result without stopping on an error
task_zh: 运行代码，出错时不中断
detail: Returns the expression's result on success; on error, emits a failure message and returns invisible NULL. quiet = TRUE suppresses the notice, warnings and messages, but keeps printed output. Use capture(data <- update(data)) to preserve an existing object if the update fails; data <- capture(update(data)) assigns NULL on error. Separate assignments in a captured block keep the last completed update; a single assignment around a failed pipeline keeps the original target. Earlier effects are not rolled back. This adapts Stata capture, which suppresses all output.
detail_zh: 成功时返回表达式结果；出错时显示失败消息，并不可见地返回 NULL。quiet = TRUE 抑制失败提示、警告和消息，但保留打印输出。使用 capture(data <- update(data)) 可在更新失败时保留原对象；data <- capture(update(data)) 会在出错时赋值为 NULL。代码块中的分步赋值保留最后完成的更新；整条管道只赋值一次时，失败会保留原对象。出错前的副作用不会回滚。这是对 Stata capture 的 R 适配，而 Stata 会抑制所有输出。

detail: avg_slopes() averages model derivatives; discrete factor changes, weights and covariance must match margins and the fitted-model context.
detail_zh: avg_slopes() 平均模型导数；因子离散变化、权重和协方差须匹配 margins 及模型上下文。

detail: by = "group" averages within observed groups; margins group sets each level for every observation before averaging. Use counterfactual predictions for that Stata estimand.
detail_zh: by = "group" 在观测组内平均；margins group 将全样本设为各水平后平均。该 Stata 目标须使用反事实预测。

detail: residuals(fit) gives residuals for the rows used in the model. predict() depends on the R model: response/link scale, residual definition and prediction sample must match the Stata postestimation context.
detail_zh: residuals(fit) 给出模型所用个案的残差。 predict() 依赖 R 模型；响应或链接尺度、残差定义及预测样本须匹配 Stata 估计后上下文。

detail: hypotheses() uses the fitted R covariance and degrees-of-freedom defaults; Stata can use a different t, F or normal reference distribution.
detail_zh: hypotheses() 使用 R 模型协方差和默认自由度；Stata 可能使用不同 t、F 或正态参照分布。

detail: A fitted model is an ordinary object; keep as many as you like under different names.
detail_zh: 模型结果是普通的对象，可以用不同的名字保存任意多个。

detail: multinom() needs a factor y for multinomial classification; reference outcome categories and optimizer defaults can differ from Stata mlogit.
detail_zh: multinom() 的多分类 y 须为因子；结果参照类别和优化器默认值可能与 Stata mlogit 不同。

r: MASS::polr(factor(y) ~ x1 + x2, data = data, Hess = TRUE)
detail: Hess = TRUE lets summary() show standard errors. polr() uses ordered factor levels and a threshold parameterization; set the order explicitly and check the cutpoint sign convention against Stata.
detail_zh: Hess = TRUE 使 summary() 能显示标准误。 polr() 使用有序因子水平和阈值参数化；须明确水平顺序并核对与 Stata 的切点符号规则。

detail_zh: polr() 使用有序因子水平和阈值参数化；须明确水平顺序并核对与 Stata 的切点符号规则。

detail: fixest::fenegbin() adds fixed effects. glm.nb() uses NB2 like default nbreg, but theta is the reciprocal of Stata alpha and likelihood/optimization reporting differs.
detail_zh: fixest::fenegbin() 可以加入固定效应。 glm.nb() 与默认 nbreg 同为 NB2，但 theta 为 Stata alpha 倒数，似然或优化报告规则不同。

r: fixest::fepois(y ~ x | id + year, data = data)
task_zh: 带固定效应的泊松模型
detail: Poisson fixed-effect coefficient targets agree, but separation/singleton removal and covariance corrections can differ; check the retained sample and uncertainty.
detail_zh: 泊松固定效应系数目标一致，但分离或单例组删除和协方差校正可能不同；须核对保留样本和不确定性。

detail: rq() default standard-error methods depend on sample size and can differ from Stata qreg; choose the covariance/inference method explicitly.
detail_zh: rq() 默认标准误方法取决于样本量，可能不同于 Stata qreg；须明确协方差和推断方法。

detail: rlm() uses Huber M-estimation; Stata's rreg combines Huber and biweight steps, so estimates can differ slightly. rlm() defaults to Huber M-estimation; rreg screens outliers and combines Huber and biweight iterations, so estimates and inference can differ.
detail_zh: rlm() 使用 Huber M 估计；Stata 的 rreg 结合了 Huber 和 biweight 权重，因此估计值可能略有不同。 rlm() 默认 Huber M 估计；rreg 筛异常值并结合 Huber 与双权迭代，估计和推断都可能不同。

detail: Match fixest covariance small-sample corrections and singleton handling with Stata; the same formula does not guarantee identical standard errors or retained observations.
detail_zh: 须匹配 fixest 协方差小样本校正和单例组处理；公式相同不能保证标准误或保留观测一致。

task_zh: 条件（固定效应）logit 模型
detail: fixest::feglm(y ~ x | id, family = binomial) is faster but estimates unconditional fixed effects. clogit() targets conditional fixed-effects logit; exact likelihood, weights and covariance settings must match xtlogit, fe rather than unconditional dummy-variable logit.
detail_zh: fixest::feglm(y ~ x | id, family = binomial) 更快，但估计的是非条件固定效应。 clogit() 对应条件固定效应 logit；精确似然、权重和协方差须匹配 xtlogit, fe，而非含虚拟变量的无条件 logit。

detail: Poisson fixed-effect coefficient targets agree, but separation/singleton removal and covariance corrections can differ; check the retained sample and uncertainty.
detail_zh: 泊松固定效应系数目标一致，但分离或单例组删除和协方差校正可能不同；须核对保留样本和不确定性。

detail: lme4 reports no p-values; lmerTest::lmer() adds them. lmer() defaults to REML; Stata mixed defaults to ML. Use REML = FALSE for ML and select a separate method for fixed-effect p-values.
detail_zh: lme4 不报告 p 值；lmerTest::lmer() 会加上。 lmer() 默认 REML，Stata mixed 默认 ML。ML 须设 REML = FALSE，固定效应 p 值还需另选方法。

r: lme4::glmer(y ~ x + (1 | id), data = data, family = binomial)
detail: glmer() defaults to Laplace integration (nAGQ = 1); melogit defaults to adaptive quadrature, which can change estimates and likelihoods.
detail_zh: glmer() 默认 Laplace 积分（nAGQ = 1）；melogit 默认自适应求积，可能改变估计和似然。

detail: lavaan treats observed exogenous predictors as fixed by default; match fixed.x and missing-data likelihood settings with Stata sem.
detail_zh: lavaan 默认将观测外生预测变量视为固定；须匹配与 Stata sem 的 fixed.x 和缺失数据似然设置。

detail: R defaults to Hartigan-Wong k-means and random initial centers; Stata initialization and iteration defaults differ. Control the starting centers to compare clusters.

detail: Standard errors use the delta method, as in Stata. hypotheses() uses the fitted R covariance and degrees-of-freedom defaults; Stata can use a different t, F or normal reference distribution.

detail: Compare the same fitted sample and likelihood constants; R classes and Stata can count scale parameters and likelihood terms differently.
detail_zh: 须比较相同估计样本和似然常数；R 类别和 Stata 对尺度参数或似然项的计数可能不同。

detail_zh: 这些选项与 Stata 默认的以拟合值为基础的检验一致。

detail_zh: 在匹配后的数据上估计效应，例如 lm(y ~ t, data = MatchIt::match.data(m), weights = weights)。

detail_zh: 需要先用 Synth::dataprep() 从面板数据生成 prep；tidysynth 提供更简洁的接口。

r: fixest::feols(y ~ treated | id + year, data = data)
detail: The TWFE coefficient alone omits didregress default group-clustered standard errors and diagnostics; specify clustering and verify the DID design.
detail_zh: 仅 TWFE 系数不含 didregress 默认组聚类标准误和诊断；须指定聚类并核对 DID 设计。

r: did::att_gt(yname = "y", tname = "year", idname = "id", gname = "first_treat", data = data)
detail: Match control-group, anticipation and estimation-method settings; csdid and att_gt() defaults and aggregation/inference need not coincide.
detail_zh: 须匹配对照组、预期效应和估计方法；csdid 与 att_gt() 的默认值、聚合和推断不保证一致。

detail: The R and Stata implementations share the estimator; version, bandwidth, mass-point and variance settings must also match for finite-sample output.
detail_zh: R 和 Stata 实现使用相同估计器；有限样本输出还须匹配版本、带宽、质量点和方差设置。

detail: fixest::fitstat(fit, ~ ivf + ivwald) reports first-stage statistics. Match fixest covariance small-sample corrections and singleton handling with Stata; the same formula does not guarantee identical standard errors or retained observations.
detail_zh: fixest::fitstat(fit, ~ ivf + ivwald) 报告第一阶段统计量。 须匹配 fixest 协方差小样本校正和单例组处理；公式相同不能保证标准误或保留观测一致。

r: oaxaca::oaxaca(y ~ x1 + x2 | group, data = data)
detail: oaxaca() reports several reference-weight decompositions; explicitly select the reference coefficients and variance method used by Stata oaxaca.
detail_zh: oaxaca() 报告多个参照权重分解；须明确选择 Stata oaxaca 使用的参照系数及方差方法。

r: plm::pgmm(y ~ lag(y, 1) + x | lag(y, 2:99), data = data, index = c("id", "year"))
detail: pgmm() needs matching transformation, lag instruments, collapse and one/two-step choices; the formula alone does not reproduce xtabond default instruments or standard errors.
detail_zh: pgmm() 须匹配变换、滞后工具、压缩和一步或两步选择；仅公式不能复现 xtabond 默认工具或标准误。

stata: mi impute chained (regress) x1 x2 = y
detail: mice() chooses methods by R column type, often predictive mean matching; it does not default to the specified chained linear regressions. Match methods, predictors and m explicitly.
detail_zh: mice() 按 R 列类型选择方法，常用预测均值匹配；默认并非指定的链式线性回归。须明确方法、预测矩阵和 m。

task: Fit and combine models across imputations
task_zh: 在多个插补数据上估计并合并结果
detail: Rubin pooling still requires matching complete-data degrees of freedom and small-sample adjustments to mi estimate.
detail_zh: Rubin 合并仍需匹配与 mi estimate 的完整数据自由度和小样本校正。

detail: tidystata needs no declaration: stata_lag(x, time = year) with .by = id, and fixest takes panel.id = ~id + year.
detail_zh: tidystata 无需声明：stata_lag(x, time = year) 配合 .by = id；fixest 用 panel.id = ~id + year。

r: mutate(data, lag_x = stata_lag(x, time = year), .by = id)
detail: Like Stata, gaps in year give missing values; dplyr::lag() shifts rows instead. Use stata_lag(x, 2, time = year) for L2.x and unit = "month" for monthly dates.
detail_zh: 与 Stata 相同，year 中断处为缺失值；dplyr::lag() 则只是按行移动。L2.x 用 stata_lag(x, 2, time = year)，月度日期加 unit = "month"。

r: mutate(data, lead_x = stata_lead(x, time = year), .by = id)
detail: Gaps in year give missing values, as in Stata.
detail_zh: 与 Stata 相同，year 中断处为缺失值。

r: mutate(data, d_x = stata_diff(x, time = year), .by = id)
detail: stata_diff(x, 2, time = year) is D2.x, the difference of differences.
detail_zh: stata_diff(x, 2, time = year) 即 D2.x（差分的差分）。

task: Add rows for missing time points
detail: fill_gaps() fills each key's observed range by default; choose .full explicitly for common panel bounds and ensure the tsibble interval matches the Stata delta.
detail_zh: fill_gaps() 默认补齐各键观测范围；共同面板边界须明确设 .full，并保证 tsibble 间隔匹配 Stata delta。

r: mutate(data, lag2_x = lag(x, 2, order_by = year), .by = id)
detail: lag(x, 2, order_by = year) shifts two observed rows; L2.x shifts two time units and returns missing across time gaps. Use stata_lag(x, 2, time = year) for that rule.
detail_zh: lag(x, 2, order_by = year) 移动两个观测行；L2.x 移动两个时间单位，遇时间缺口返回缺失。该规则应使用 stata_lag(x, 2, time = year)。

r: data |> mutate(m = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), .by = id) |> summarise(overall = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), within = sd(x - m, na.rm = TRUE))
detail: The between part is the standard deviation of the id means: summarise(data, m = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), .by = id) then sd(m).
detail_zh: 组间部分是各 id 均值的标准差：先 summarise(data, m = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), .by = id)，再求 sd(m)。

task: One line plot per panel unit
task_zh: 每个面板个体一张折线图
detail: aes(group = id) without facets draws all units in one plot, like the overlay option.
detail_zh: 不分面而使用 aes(group = id) 会把所有个体画在一张图上，相当于 overlay 选项。

detail: R and Stata ARIMA initialization and intercept parameterizations differ; match the likelihood method and transform intercepts before comparing coefficients.
detail_zh: R 和 Stata ARIMA 初始化及截距参数化不同；比较系数前须匹配似然方法并转换截距。

task: Carry the last observed value forward
task_zh: 用上一个非缺失值向下填充
detail: group_by(data, id) first to fill within each panel unit. fill() crosses panel boundaries unless grouped first; group_by(id) is needed for within-unit carryforward.
detail_zh: 先 group_by(data, id) 即可在每个面板个体内填充。 fill() 未先分组时会跨面板单位填补；单位内 carryforward 须先 group_by(id)。

detail: R has no declaration step: Surv(time, died) goes on the left of each model formula.
detail_zh: R 不需要声明：在每个模型公式左边写 Surv(time, died) 即可。

r: survival::coxph(survival::Surv(time, died) ~ x1 + x2, data = data)
detail: exp(coef(fit)) gives the hazard ratios that stcox reports. coxph() defaults to Efron handling of ties; Stata stcox defaults to Breslow. Set ties = "breslow" to match tied-event likelihoods.
detail_zh: exp(coef(fit)) 给出 stcox 报告的风险比。 coxph() 默认用 Efron 处理并列事件；Stata stcox 默认 Breslow。设 ties = "breslow" 可匹配并列事件似然。

r: survival::survreg(survival::Surv(time, died) ~ x, data = data, dist = "weibull")
detail: survreg() reports the accelerated failure-time form; Stata's Weibull default is the hazard form, so signs and scales differ.
detail_zh: survreg() 报告加速失效时间形式；Stata 的 Weibull 默认使用风险形式，因此符号和尺度不同。

detail: statar::stat_binmean() adds binned means to a ggplot: ggplot(data, aes(x, y)) + statar::stat_binmean(n = 20). binsreg() defaults to data-driven bin selection and inference; binscatter defaults to fixed quantile bins and an OLS fit. Match bins and fit settings explicitly.
detail_zh: statar::stat_binmean() 可以在 ggplot 中加入分箱均值：ggplot(data, aes(x, y)) + statar::stat_binmean(n = 20)。 binsreg() 默认数据驱动分箱和推断；binscatter 默认固定分位箱和 OLS 拟合。须明确匹配分箱和拟合设置。
